chapters.content:
# Bab 1: Asas-Asas Hukum Pidana

## Asas Legalitas
Asas legalitas (Nullum delictum nulla poena sine praevia lege poenali) adalah asas fundamental dalam hukum pidana Indonesia. Pasal 1 ayat (1) KUHP menegaskan bahwa tiada suatu perbuatan dapat dipidana kecuali atas kekuatan aturan pidana dalam perundang-undangan yang telah ada sebelum perbuatan dilakukan.

## Asas Teritorialitas
Hukum pidana Indonesia berlaku bagi siapa saja yang melakukan tindak pidana di wilayah negara Republik Indonesia.
chapters.contentEn:
# Chapter 1: Principles of Criminal Law

## Principle of Legality
The principle of legality is a fundamental principle in Indonesian criminal law. Article 1 paragraph (1) of the Criminal Code asserts that no act shall be punished except by virtue of a criminal statutory provision which precedes it.

## Principle of Territoriality
Indonesian criminal law applies to anyone who commits a criminal offense within the territory of the Republic of Indonesia.

chapters.content:
# Bab 2: Tindak Pidana dan Pertanggungjawaban Pidana

## Unsur-Unsur Tindak Pidana
Tindak pidana terdiri dari unsur objektif (perbuatan, akibat, keadaan) dan unsur subjektif (kesengajaan, kealpaan, niat).

## Pertanggungjawaban Pidana
Seseorang hanya dapat dipidana jika memiliki kesalahan (schuld), baik berupa kesengajaan (dolus) maupun kealpaan (culpa), dan mampu bertanggung jawab atas perbuatannya.
chapters.contentEn:
# Chapter 2: Criminal Offenses and Criminal Liability

## Elements of a Criminal Offense
A criminal offense consists of objective elements (act, consequence, circumstances) and subjective elements (intent, negligence, motive).

## Criminal Liability
A person can only be punished if they have culpability, either in the form of intent or negligence, and are capable of taking responsibility for their actions.
